remarks: Rare mid-century modern elevated waterfront property with extraordinary views in historic Village Creek. A fabulous opportunity to restore and enhance the prized founders lot in this unique coastal community offering a marina, sandy beach, tennis courts and park--just minutes from SoNo, Rowayton, and the train to NYC.    The interior of the 5 bedroom house has been demoed, and is offered with P&Z approved plans designed by an award winning architect. Plans feature a new primary suite with en-suite bath, and 4 additional bedrooms & 2 bathrooms on the lower level - each opening to a terrace. On the upper level, the main living spaces enjoy three-sided exposure, filling the rooms with light and sweeping views of LI Sound. The wraparound deck and planned screened in porch with fireplace offer seamless indoor-outdoor living. The natural stone stairs in the rear lead to the community beach and marina with boat slips available to owners.     Plans for the second level over the detached 2 car garage include an art studio with full bathroom, and large panels of glass with beautiful water views. The all new septic system accomodates 6 bedrooms, significant tree work has been completed to maximize views while maintaining privacy, and the pool envelope has been flagged for a pool with views. A once-in-a-lifetime offering-an effortlessly stylish, mid-century modern home ready for renovation with the best views on the Connecticut coast.
